cards.name: Alakazam
cards.description: Its brain can outperform a supercomputer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5000.

cards.name: Flareon
cards.description: When storing thermal energy in its body, its temperature could soar to over 1600 degrees.

cards.name: Gengar
cards.description: Under a full moon, this Pokémon like to mimic the shadows of people and laugh at their fright.

cards.name: Gyarados
cards.description: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.

cards.name: Hitmonlee
cards.description: When in a hurry, its legs lengthen progressively. It runs smoothly with extra long, loping strides.

cards.name: Jolteon
cards.description: It accumulates negative ions from the atmosphere to blast out 10,000-volt lightning bolts.

cards.name: Machamp
cards.description: Using its amazing muscles, it throws powerful punches that can knock its victim clear over the horizon.

cards.name: Muk
cards.description: Thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.

cards.name: Ninetales
cards.description: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

cards.name: Venusaur
cards.description: This plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

cards.name: Zapdos
cards.description: A legendary bird Pokémon said to appear from clouds while wielding enormous lightning bolts.

cards.name: Articuno
cards.description: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.

cards.name: Beedrill
cards.description: Flies at high speed and attacks using the large, venomous stingers on its forelegs and tail.

cards.name: Butterfree
cards.description: In battle, it flaps its wings at high speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

cards.name: Electrode
cards.description: It stores electrical energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.

cards.name: Exeggutor
cards.description: Legend has it that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an Exeggcute.

cards.name: Golem
cards.description: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without damage.

cards.name: Hypno
cards.description: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of psi moves such as Hypnosis and Confusion.

cards.name: Jynx
cards.description: Merely by meditating, the Pokémon launches a powerful psychic energy attack.

cards.name: Kabutops
cards.description: Its sleek shape is perfect for swimming. It slashes prey with its claws and drains the body fluids.

cards.name: Magneton
cards.description: Formed by several Magnemites linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.

cards.name: Mewtwo
cards.description: A scientist created this Pokémon after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA engineering experiments.

cards.name: Charizard
cards.description: Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to unintentionally cause forest fires.

cards.name: Moltres
cards.description: Known as the legendary bird of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flash of flames.

cards.name: Nidoking
cards.description: Uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break its prey's bones.

cards.name: Nidoqueen
cards.description: Its hard scales provide strong protection. It uses its hefty bulk to execute powerful moves.

cards.name: Pidgeot
cards.description: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as Magikarp.

cards.name: Pidgeotto
cards.description: Very protective of its sprawling territory, this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.

cards.name: Rhydon
cards.description: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3600 degrees.

cards.name: Arcanine
cards.description: A Pokémon that has been long admired for its beauty. It runs gracefully, as if on wings.

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.description: When it swings its burning tail, it raises the temperature to unbearably high levels.

cards.name: Dark Dragonair
cards.description: As is fitting for a legendary Pokémon, it has many strange powers, including the ability to make rain or snow fall.

cards.name: Dark Wartortle
cards.description: A Pokémon with a negative attitude, it hides in its shell whenever it's in a bad mood—which is often.

cards.name: Dark Blastoise
cards.description: An aggressive Pokémon that tackles anything it sees.

cards.name: Dewgong
cards.description: Stores thermal energy in its body. Swims at a steady 8 knots even in intensely cold waters.

cards.name: Dodrio
cards.description: Uses its three brains to execute complex plans. While two heads sleep, one head stays awake.

cards.name: Fearow
cards.description: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land for rest.

cards.name: Golduck
cards.description: Often seen swimming elegantly by lake shores. It is often mistaken for the Japanese monster, Kappa.

cards.name: Graveler
cards.description: Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over any obstacle without slowing or changing its direction.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.description: Very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.

cards.name: Haunter
cards.description: Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from another dimension.

cards.name: Ivysaur
cards.description: When the bulb on its back grows large, the Pokémon seems to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

cards.name: Kabuto
cards.description: A Pokémon that was resurrected from a fossil found in what was once the ocean floor eons ago.

cards.name: Kadabra
cards.description: It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches even to those just nearby.

cards.name: Dark Dragonite
cards.description: Sometimes called "The God of Destruction." Its wings are able to support it in spite of its massive weight.

cards.name: Kakuna
cards.description: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself from predators.

cards.name: Machoke
cards.description: Its muscular body is so powerful that it must wear a power-save belt to help regulate its motions.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.description: In the distant past, it was stronger than its horribly weak descendants that exist today.

cards.name: Meowth
cards.description: Adores circular objects. Wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

cards.name: Metapod
cards.description: It is vulnerable to attack because its shell is soft, exposing its weak and tender body.

cards.name: Nidorina
cards.description: The female's horn develops slowly. Prefers physical attacks such as clawing and biting.

cards.name: Nidorino
cards.description: An aggressive Pokémon that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.

cards.name: Omanyte
cards.description: Although long extinct, in rare cases, it can be genetically resurrected from fossils.

cards.name: Omastar
cards.description: A prehistoric Pokémon that died out when its heavy shell made it impossible for it to catch prey.

cards.name: Primeape
cards.description: Always furious and tenacious to boot. It will not abandon chasing its quarry until its quarry is caught.

cards.name: Dark Persian
cards.description: Popular with women because of its beautiful fur. The leader of the Rockets keeps one as a pet.

cards.name: Rapidash
cards.description: Very competitive, this Pokémon will chase anything that moves fast in the hope of racing it.

cards.name: Raticate
cards.description: It uses its whiskers to maintain its balance. It seems to slow down if they are cut off.

cards.name: Sandslash
cards.description: Curls up into a spiny ball when threatened. It can roll while curled up to attack or escape.

cards.name: Seadra
cards.description: Capable of swimming backward by rapidly flapping its wing-like pectoral fins and stout tail.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.description: Very lazy. Just eats and sleeps. As its rotund bulk builds, it becomes steadily more slothful.

cards.name: Tauros
cards.description: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.

cards.name: Tentacruel
cards.description: The tentacles are normally kept short. On hunts, the are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey.

cards.name: Abra
cards.description: Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and teleport to safety.

cards.name: Bulbasaur
cards.description: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. Thus, a plant sprouted and now grows with this Pokémon.

cards.name: Caterpie
cards.description: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

cards.name: Dark Raichu
cards.description: Stores up electricity in its body, then suddenly releases it to surprise and shock everyone.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.description: Obviously prefers hot places. If it gets caught in the rain, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

cards.name: Doduo
cards.description: A bird that makes up for its poor flying with its fast foot speed. Leaves giant footprints.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.description: Long considered a mythical Pokémon until recently, when a small colony was found living underwater.

cards.name: Drowzee
cards.description: Not popular with girls because of its attitude. Can often be heard muttering to itself in a low voice.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.description: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from elemental stones.

cards.name: Exeggcute
cards.description: Often mistaken for eggs. When disturbed, they quickly gather and attack in swarms.

cards.name: Gastly
cards.description: A mysterious Pokémon. Some say it is a lifeform from another dimension, while others believe it is formed from smog.

cards.name: Geodude
cards.description: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.

cards.name: Grimer
cards.description: Appears in filthy areas. Thrives by sucking up polluted sludge that is pumped out of factories.

cards.name: Machop
cards.description: It's said that not even pro wrestlers can take down a Machop.

cards.name: Dark Slowbro
cards.description: It loves nothing better than to be left alone, and so sometimes ends up being manipulated by unscrupulous people.

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.description: Uses anti-gravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses attacks like Thunder Wave.

cards.name: Mankey
cards.description: Normally friendly, it quickly becomes angry if it doesn't get what it wants.

cards.name: Nidoran ♀
cards.description: Although small, its venomous barbs make this Pokémon dangerous. The female has smaller horns.

cards.name: Nidoran ♂
cards.description: Stiffens its ears to sense danger. The larger, more powerful of its horns secretes venom.

cards.name: Onix
cards.description: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to a diamond, though colored black.

cards.name: Pidgey
cards.description: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can build and cause lightning storms.

cards.name: Ponyta
cards.description: Its hooves are 10 times harder than diamonds. It can trample anything flat in moments.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.description: It is often seen holding its head in its paws, as if it were suffering from a headache.

cards.name: Rattata
cards.description: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.

cards.name: Dark Vaporeon
cards.description: A Pokémon capable of controlling water, so it is capable of creating giant whirlpools.

cards.name: Rhyhorn
cards.description: Its massive bones are 1,000 times harder than human bones. It can easily knock a trailer flying.

cards.name: Sandshrew
cards.description: Burrow deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for food.

cards.name: Seel
cards.description: The protruding horn on its head is very hard. This horn is used for bashing through thick ice.

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.description: Incredibly slow and dopey. It takes 5 seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.

cards.name: Spearow
cards.description: Eats bugs in grassy areas. It has to flap its short wings at high speed to stay airborne.

cards.name: Squirtle
cards.description: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. It powerfully sprays foam from its mouth.

cards.name: Tentacool
cards.description: Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by its stinging acid.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.description: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

cards.name: Vulpix
cards.description: At the time of birth, it has just one tail. Its tail splits from the tip as it grows older.

cards.name: Weedle
cards.description: Often found in forests, eating leaves. It has a sharp, venomous stinger on its head.
